products.title: 2-Piece Multi-Level Rack for L
products.body_html:
This 2-part Multi Level Rack consists of two components: a stainless steel grid and an elevated grid that allows you to work on multiple levels, thereby doubling your cooking capacity. This means twice as many delicious dishes.

The elevated cooking grid provides 10 cm of clearance for easy access. It can be used upside down for "Cowboy Style" low-level grilling. Designed to attach to the standard stainless steel grid, it's a starter component for the EGGspander System and works with the convEGGtor basket.

Features:

  • Elevated cooking grid with 10 cm clearance for easy access
  • Can be used upside down for "Cowboy Style" low-level grilling
  • Designed to attach to the standard stainless steel grid
  • Starter component for EGGspander System; compatible with convEGGtor basket

If you're short on cooking space, it's time to address the issue with this Multi Level Rack, which effectively doubles your cooking capacity.

products.title: 5-Piece EGGspander Kit for L
products.body_html:
Take your cooking to the next level with the 5-Piece EGGspander Kit for the Large Egg. This all-in-one system opens up a world of cooking possibilities, making sure you get the most out of your Egg. With interchangeable components, you can effortlessly switch between direct and indirect heat, create multi-tier setups, or maximize cooking space for large gatherings.

The EGGspander System seamlessly integrates with your existing setup, enhancing your outdoor cooking capabilities and inspiring culinary exploration. Whether you're smoking a brisket, roasting vegetables, grilling steaks, or all of the above - this versatile system adapts to your cooking style, helping you achieve restaurant-quality results at home.

products.title: convEGGtor® Basket for 2XL EGG (use with 2 Half Moon convEGGtor for 2XL)
products.body_html:
The Big Green Egg 2XL is a versatile outdoor cooker that offers exceptional cooking capabilities. This innovative outdoor cooker features a dual-zone metal and ceramic convEGGtor system, enabling seamless transitions between direct and indirect cooking methods. The redesigned convEGGtor combines a sturdy basket with two half baking stones, offering precise temperature control across an expansive 672 square inch (4,335 cm²) cooking surface. Grill, smoke, roast, bake, and sear with professional-grade results, all within a single, elegantly engineered unit.

The 2XL's convEGGtor system revolutionizes outdoor cooking:

  • Cooking area: 672 sq in (4,335 cm²)
  • Temperature range: 150°F to 750°F (66°C to 399°C)
  • Weight: 375 lbs (170 kg)
  • Materials: Ceramic body, stainless steel components

This advanced cooking system harnesses the power of social proof, with top chefs and culinary enthusiasts worldwide embracing its capabilities. The limited availability of the 2XL model creates a sense of scarcity, making it a coveted addition to any outdoor kitchen. By investing in this premium cooker, you're not just buying a grill – you're joining an exclusive community of passionate outdoor cooking enthusiasts.

products.title: Half Moon Cast Iron Plancha Griddle (2XL, XL)
products.body_html:
Every coin has two sides. The same goes for the Half Cast Iron Plancha Griddle. The ridged side is excellent for fish fillets or hot sandwiches, while the smooth side is perfect for frying eggs, blinis, or pancakes. Since this cast iron griddle only covers half of the grate in your Big Green Egg, you still have room to grill.

The best way to start your day? A breakfast cooked on the Big Green Egg! Eggs, bacon, pork, sausages, sautéed tomatoes, mushrooms, and a stack of American pancakes served with blueberries. With the Half Cast Iron Plancha Griddle, you can serve all of this in no time.
